hypothesis: Legal public causal observations from four separated noisy role-identified A probes contain enough jointly necessary information to choose a physically consequential intervention after a long delay and distracting independent B probes in an A-to-B-to-A regime. A legal compositional memory rule should substantially beat fixed, shuffled, short-cue and recent-B controls on fresh CALIBRATION, establishing task feasibility but not that a Hybrid or small GRU can learn it.
null: If legal A-parity memory policy fails ANY predeclared two-seed information or control margin, stop this frozen task; preserve NO_GO, do not retune or generate sealed panels. Even a pass is a calibration result only; conventional control headroom and scientific learning are unverified.

source.access_now: CALIBRATION ONLY; QUALIFICATION_SEALED, DEV_SEALED, OOD_SEALED are never generated by R85
source.factor_generation: Four private independent signed factors for original A except final factor determined to yield a pre-balanced A parity sign, with 128 positive and 128 negative A laws in each early/cold stratum; four private independent B signs, B phase independent of A. Factor values/target law not provided directly as model input.
source.seed_and_index: numpy SeedSequence([CALIBRATION_salt, seed, world_index]); public time/pivot does not encode A parity; world index is never supplied to policy.
source.selected_observation: 13D float32 current chosen action onehot4, prior actual chosen action onehot4, prior actual selected public observation4, normalized public time; no privileged law, counterfactual, current selected reward, or future consequence.
source.probe: At eight predeclared A/B probe times, actually execute PROBE action1; next public observation contains (reward=-0.1+noise, role_id=(role+1)/4, noisy signed factor in obs2 = sign+0.4*Gaussian, phase_marker=+1 for A/-1 for B). Roles permuted within each four-probe phase by seeded independent RNG. No other action/observation before the decision reveals A or B factors or actuator return.
source.public_prefix: At pivot action row candidate CALIBRATE0 versus EXPLOIT_POS2; earlier public prefix identical; CALIBRATE changes internal actuator to current parity law and costs -0.5, EXPLOIT_POS leaves actuator unset; eight later common EXPLOIT_POS; paired evaluator branches share all exogenous noise; only chosen reward is visible to a policy after decision.
source.dynamics: At pivot if CALIBRATE then return=-0.5; if EXPLOIT_POS then return=0.2*law-0.1+0.1*noise; each subsequent EXPLOIT_POS returns law if actuator matches law, else 0.2*law-0.1, plus 0.1*same innovation. Negative-law calibration is harmful; positive-law calibration is beneficial.
source.future_only_perturbation: Changing innovations and actions strictly after pivot must not change any public prefix; paired branch prefixes must differ only at current chosen-action onehot.

legal_policies.PUBLIC_A_PARITY_MEMORY_RULE: From actually observed public prefix, select only +1-phase PROBE observations, group using their public role_id, threshold four noisy selected factor cues and multiply their signs; CALIBRATE iff product>0. No hidden law or world-index access.
legal_policies.LAST_A_CUE_NEGATIVE: Same public A observations, choose based solely on sign of the last A probe; not a compositional memory rule.
legal_policies.RECENT_B_PARITY_NEGATIVE: At cold pivot, take product of B cues (wrong regime), at early use last A sign; does not know true A law.
legal_policies.SHUFFLED_A_CUES_NEGATIVE: Within same early/cold stratum, replace the complete four-cue public A trace with another world while keeping the target physical world unchanged; preserve cue and time marginal distributions.
legal_policies.BEST_FIXED_EVALUATOR: Optimistic max of always-CALIBRATE and always-EXPLOIT realized mean reward; evaluator only.
legal_policies.PAIRED_PHYSICAL_ORACLE_EVALUATOR: After-the-fact max realized branch per world, never available to legal policy.

next_distinct_frozen_learner_study: Only if R85 calibration passes, prospectively freeze a DIFFERENT study with full max-width native and blinded native, fully trained GRU64/GRU256/stronger recurrent and explicit legal memory rule, matched legal history/action, cost/compute/exposure ledgers, cold return/shifted structural OOD and both-seed preregistered confidence thresholds. This R85 calibration alone cannot prove GRU headroom, learned memory, transfer, or benefit.
